meta.doc: 04 §2.1 / §2.2 — the PLACEMENT rules for player-placed grid components.
meta._price_note: This file contains NO prices and quotes none, not even in a comment (report 98 C-07: one table, one place). Every dollar the placement layer spends is read at runtime from data/economy.json expenses.grid_components, which is doc 03 §2.13(b).
meta._capacity_note: This file contains NO capacities, thermal constants or protection settings. Those are doc 04 §8's data/power.json; sim/power/power_grid.gd mirrors them inline until that file lands (the P0-01 pattern). service_radius_tiles below is repeated here ONLY so the placement layer has a data source, and CitySim asserts it equals PowerGrid.TRANSFORMER_SERVICE_RADIUS at boot.
meta._scope_note: Doc 04 §4 lists place_power_component, upgrade_power_component, demolish_power_component, route_feeder, place_tie … . Wave 1.5 ships placement of the one component that unblocks E_UNSERVED: the transformer. Everything else stays unplaceable until its command lands.

transformer._placeable_levels_note: Doc 04 §6 MVP ships transformer L1–L4; the Wave-1.5 placement roster is L1–L3 (audit doc 93 §B). Raising the cap is a data edit, not a code edit.
transformer._feeder_tap_note: Doc 04 §2.1 makes the transformer a child of exactly one feeder but states no tap distance, because line routing is player-drawn (report 98 C-41) and route_feeder has not shipped. Until it does, placement taps the NEAREST feeder within this radius and charges the doc 03 §2.13(b) per-tile feeder price for the lateral tiles it adds to that feeder's route (so line_km, and therefore E_grid, grow honestly). 8 is fixed twice over: it is half a 16x16 land block (constitution §6), so the utility_corridor development phase running a trunk to a block's centre puts every tile of that block — corners included — in reach of one transformer; and it is the authored starter city's own worst transformer-to-nearest-feeder Chebyshev distance, at T-05 (31,1) and T-09 (15,5), so the shipped topology is exactly reproducible by the player's own verb. Tests assert both properties against data/starter_city.json rather than against this number.

priority._classes_note: Doc 04 §2.4's PRIORITY_WEIGHT ladder — 1000 / 40 / 8 / 1. Audit doc 93 §B writes the middle tier as 'PRIORITY'; the alias below accepts that spelling so the UI may use either.
